performance.method: Sequential pairs, full quality, 1400x960, 30 warmup and 60 measured frames, Godot 4.4.1, Xvfb and llvmpipe with LP_NUM_THREADS=2. Normal and dense workload scripts are byte-identical in both revisions. No other game tests/imports ran concurrently. Rechecks isolate one dense case and reverse the revision order.
limitations: Software renderer on a shared host; update timings include wall-clock scheduling and native calls.
Native particles/tweens frozen by the scripted harness; not a complete live hardware frame profile.
Large and inconsistent frame/p95 spikes occurred in both revisions; these runs do not establish a reliable FPS gain or uniform regression.
Physical Windows/Android/iOS FPS and human boss-balance playtesting remain outstanding.
